svg.title: Annotated Kepryx dashboard screenshot
svg.desc: The dashboard screenshot with focus boxes around the posture KPI strip, the relationship map controls, and the alert and recent-change evidence.
svg.text: Dashboard evidence · focus areas for the recording
Illustrative local evidence from the verified preview build; values are point-in-time and may change after a fresh run.
Asset, severity, shadow-IT, alert, and KEV counts establish the opening frame.
Filter, reshape, focus, drag, pin, zoom, and scrub time. Use the node list when dense.
A risk signal becomes an operator queue. Resolve it only after inspecting evidence.
Audit-friendly activity makes the state change visible instead of hiding it behind the UI.
Narrative: “This is not a decorative dashboard; each focus area points to a live API-backed signal.”
